sources.note: Main website. Describes Elation as clinical-first, AI-native EHR for primary care. Mentions 300+ integrations, unified EHR + billing, Note Assist AI scribe, Best in KLAS 2026.

ONC certification disclosure page. Lists Elation Health version 3.0, certification ID 15.04.04.2717.Elat.03.00.1.181231, Surescripts integration, subscription pricing model, FHIR US Core v4.0.0 support.
EHR product page. Details three-panel console, clinical orders, ePrescribing, referral management with Ribbon directory, telehealth via Zoom, Note Assist AI, mobile app, 300+ integrations.
Billing product page. Describes real-time eligibility, automated charge capture, claim scrubbing, ERA posting, copay collection, 100+ pre-built reports, 98% claims paid within 90 days.
Practice management page. Covers scheduling, intake, document management, automated reminders, reporting, Patient Passport portal, 99.98% uptime.

Unified EHR overview. Confirms single platform for clinical records + patient payments. Lists clinical orders, referral management, Patient Passport, telehealth, scheduling, billing, 300+ integrations.
EPCS page. Confirms certified EPCS capability with two-factor authentication for controlled substance prescribing.
Developer platform page. Open RESTful API and webhook catalog, FHIR-first design, developer sandbox, supports scheduling, messaging, intake forms, and mobile health app integrations.
2025 year-end press release. Reports 46,000+ clinical users, 24M+ patients, 600+ new customers added, Best in KLAS for EHR/PM, new pediatric tools launched.
DPC resource hub. Elation positions itself as a leading EHR for Direct Primary Care with dedicated membership management features.
Membership management page. DPC membership tracking and recurring payment features for non-insurance-based practice models.
SelectHub review. Ranked #7 on EHR leaderboard. Perfect 100 score for charting. Notes advanced billing limitations (no digital wallet, limited denial resolution). Pricing $100-$500 range.

FindEMR review. 52 reviews, 4-star average, 70% excellent. Details charting with structured templates/macros, billing with claim submission, scheduling, patient portal with secure messaging, care management with registries and outreach campaigns.
SoftwareFinder listing. Confirms cloud-based platform for small/mid-sized practices, AI documentation in 12 languages, telehealth, ePrescribing, lab interfaces, patient portal.
Help article on EPCS prescribing workflow. Confirms Rx/OTC and Controlled substance buttons in visit note, two-step authentication for EPCS.
